title: Hyatt Regency walkways: hanger-rod connection redesign and inadequate load-path capacity
summary: Hyatt Regency is encoded as a structural load-path/design-change review record: a connection and hanger-rod arrangement carried far less capacity than assumed, and a construction-stage connection change doubled connection load relative to the original concept.

status_history.note: Added as civil/structural failure lane record.

subjects.name: Hyatt Regency Kansas City suspended walkways

claims.claim: The NIST publication page identifies the Hyatt Regency walkway-collapse report and describes the investigation as covering two suspended walkways whose collapse was studied through on-site inspections, laboratory tests, and analytical studies.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The NBS report identifies the most probable cause as insufficient load capacity of the box-beam to hanger-rod connections that supported the walkways.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The NBS report identifies two connection-level factors: inadequate original design and a hanger-rod arrangement change during construction that doubled the load on the upper walkway box-beam hanger-rod connections.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The record is encoded as a load-path/design-change review failure because the source-bounded causal grain is not simply collapse, but a critical connection whose as-built load path did not have the capacity assumed by design and review.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

type_payload.system: suspended pedestrian walkways, hanger rods, box-beam connections, design/detailing/review process

sequence_of_events.event: Suspended walkways were designed and constructed with hanger-rod/box-beam connections.
A construction-stage hanger-rod arrangement change altered the connection load path.
Critical connections lacked adequate load capacity for the imposed loads.
Walkways collapsed and NBS/NIST investigated the structural and design-detailing cause chain.

type_payload.proximate_cause: Insufficient load capacity in box-beam/hanger-rod connections.
contributing_factors: as-built hanger-rod arrangement change that doubled upper-connection load
failure to catch load-path consequence in review
latent_conditions: connection-detailing and construction-change assumptions not made sufficiently visible
design review did not serve as an independent load-path check
occupancy load consequence was hidden inside a local connection detail
